items.quote: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.
items.contrast: The region entered after leaving the camp versus the earlier campsite near Kiriath Jearim in Judah.
items.reason: “From there” refers to the camp near Kiriath Jearim, and the next destination is explicitly the hill country of Ephraim. The question clearly tests the sequence of locations rather than mere place-name retrieval.
